versions.content: Memory stack shall process multiple requests in parallel Type: draft Description: The memory stack shall handle several Flash devices. Those devices may or may not be accessed in parallel. Depending on the managed devices the memory stack shall process multiple requests in parallel. Rationale: Process multiple requests in parallel. Dependencies: Use Case: Program and data flash work independently but may be handled by one single memory driver. The driver forwards one request to each of the devices, if available, instead of processing them subsequently. Supporting Material:
